narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to an exciting journey into the world of Linear Equations in Two Variables. In this chapter, we'll explore how to represent real-life situations using mathematical equations and solve them systematically. Get ready to build a strong foundation for many advanced topics in mathematics!
